name: Sip & Connect: Love & Ambition
description:
Madrid is home to so many ambitious women, it's time we all actually knew each other.
That's why we're back for a new season of Sip & Connect and our much requested topic: Love & Ambition, an evening designed for ambitious women who are ready to talk honestly about one of the most overlooked parts of building a big life, love.
Being an ambitious woman is incredible. But it comes with a unique set of challenges that nobody really talks about. How do you date when you're driven, independent, and deeply committed to what you're building? How do you maintain a relationship without losing yourself or your momentum? And how do you find someone who genuinely celebrates who you are rather than feeling threatened by it? Whether you're single and navigating modern dating as an ambitious woman, or you're in a relationship trying to make ambition and love coexist, this evening is for you.
Our speaker is Anastasiia Gavrilova, matchmaker and founder of Primitive Thing. Through her own experiences, including her marriage, its breakdown, and life as a conscious, intentional dater since as well as through the ambitious, accomplished singles she works with every day, Anastasiia has developed a very particular perspective on what it really takes for ambitious women to build relationships without compromising who they are.
📍 Bravo Wine Bar, Madrid🗓 Tuesday 15th September | 8:00 PM – 11:00 PM🍷 1 drink is included in your ticket
Come for the conversation, stay for the connection, and leave with a fresh perspective on what it really takes to build love without compromising who you are.
Connect with us on Instagram: @foundhermadrid
By signing up, you acknowledge that the event may be digitally recorded and that photos or videos including attendees may be shared on social media.

name: Intro Only: Back to The City 🖤
description:
Let’s have a flirty night back in Madrid, shall we? 🍸
A few months ago, I invited all my single friends to a bar and told them to bring their single friends. We ended up with 40 people in one bar who all just happened to be single.
I made a video about it and you guys kinda went crazy over it.
A few dates came out of it, and two people that met that night are now fully boyfriend & girlfriend. So naturally, we have to do it again.
This September aka the BEST month in Madrid, I’m recreating the night, but this time opening it up beyond my close friends.
The concept is simple:
You + one single friend.
Each ticket admits two people. To keep the room curated and preserve the friends-of-friends feeling that made the first night so special, registration is approval-based.
I’ll just ask you to share your Instagram or LinkedIn so I can put a face to the name and make sure everyone joining is a real human. Your Instagram absolutely does not need to be public — a profile photo where I can see who you are is enough!
Come for drinks, make new friends, flirt a little, and see what happens 🖤
HOW IT WORKS
Request to join + share your Instagram or LinkedIn.

Once approved, you will receive your ticket for you & your +1.

Show up, meet new people, and have a fun night

Just friends bringing friends together in real life… who just so happen to be single.
***When you register, you will see a charge from Luma that is a "hold" charge. If I approve you to come the charge goes through, and if you don't get approved the charge is removed and you do not get charged***
The amount of girls to register has reached capacity, I'm waiting for more guys to register and I will then approve the final group!
Tickets do not come with a drink included. Drinks will be available for purchase at the bar :)
This event is exclusively for ages 20-40.

name: The Final Pitch: baby vc Madrid Meetup
description:
Tick-tock... The baby vc bootcamp applications are almost closing! ⏳ apply here
Join us on Thursday, September 17th, for an exclusive, laid-back evening with the baby vc Madrid organizers and alumni.
Whether you’re still polishing your application or you’ve already hit "submit", this is the perfect chance to connect with the local venture capital ecosystem over some cañas and good conversation.
Why should you join us?
Still finishing your application? Get your last-minute questions answered directly by people who have been through the bootcamp. Find out exactly what the 10-week fellowship is like and what we look for in candidates.

Already applied? Amazing! Come meet the team face-to-face and show us your passion for VC. We love seeing our applicants go the extra mile to engage with the community, consider this a great way to stand out!

Want to build your network? Meet like-minded peers who are also navigating their way into the venture capital world.

Just bring yourself and whatever questions are on your mind!
About baby vc: baby vc is a free 10-week fellowship designed to help driven individuals from all backgrounds break into venture capital.
Reminder: Applications for the upcoming bootcamp close September 21. Don't miss your chance!
